description: Read a store document by path: Plans (.plans), playbooks (.playbooks), memory and design guide (.memory), brand kit (.brand) and projects (.projects). Also the store’s SEO and AI search reports, the same numbers the merchant sees in Fudge, read-only and never collecting new data: `.seo/reports/index.md` holds every report’s headline with its source, period and scope; `.seo/reports/<id>.md` one report’s rows, with filters and the next page as `?name=value` (each file lists its own); `.seo/results/changes.md` what each published change did to Google clicks and visits; `.seo/results/opportunities.md` the pages worth on-page work. Omit `path` to list top-level folders; a folder path lists its documents.

path.description: Document or folder path, optionally with its ?query.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: read_store_document
title: Read store document
